Interface PatchPanel

All Known Implementing Classes:
PatchPanelJson
public interface PatchPanel
A patch panel available for cross-connect ordering. The list endpoint (ListPatchPanels) populates the summary fields; the detail endpoint (GetPatchPanel) additionally populates the cage/cabinet, port and connection-service details.
